summary: Frontend-only E2E verification of the 5 layered PTT auto-clip enhancements (mix limiter, late joiners, talk trim, clip notes, 48h retention) plus the full iteration_11 regression suite, on the preview URL with a synthetic oscillator getUserMedia override. RESULTS: 4 of 5 new features fully PASS; the mix limiter only PARTIALLY meets the '<=1.0 peak' goal. Details — (1) TALK TRIM: PASS. 2.0s press + 6s wait produced duration_ms=7014 / talk_duration_ms=2013 in IDB; row shows '2.0S · 22.0 KB' (not 7s); extend-on-repress clip: duration 11035 / talk 6033 (single clip); toast text 'Clip saved · 8.2s' uses talk_duration_ms. (2) CLIP NOTES: PASS. Typed a 312-char note into my-clips-note-0, Enter blurred and saved; UI kept 200 chars, IDB note length = 200 (truncation works); after page reload the note came back from IDB ('Reminder about sales call Remi…'); a second clip's note ('synthetic') also round-tripped. (3) TTL BADGE: PASS. my-clips-ttl-<i> renders '47H LEFT' for a fresh clip and '46H LEFT' for a 1h-old clip (uppercase is CSS `uppercase`, underlying text '47h left'); border class is grey #E8E8E3 (no #C84C4C) while >6h remain. (4) 48H PURGE: PASS. Injected two synthetic clips via indexedDB ('STALE_CLIP' created_at=-3d, 'FRESH_CLIP' created_at=-1h); after reload IDB contained only the real clip + FRESH_CLIP, STALE_CLIP purged, popover showed 2 rows and count badge '2'. (5) LATE JOINERS: PASS. Alice held PTT, Bob (700Hz oscillator, open mic) joined + published ~2s into the recording. Goertzel analysis of the decoded clip: 700Hz magnitude early=0.1 vs late=15657 (Bob spliced into the live mix mid-clip); Alice's 300Hz present early (15971) and gone after release. (6) MIX LIMITER: PARTIAL — see backend/frontend issues. Regression (iteration_11, all PASS): empty state text + no count badge at 0; auto-record on PTT; extend-on-repress => exactly 1 clip; multiple clips newest-first (row0 06:11:53 > row1 06:11:40, badge 2); play/pause (audio paused=false, currentTime 1.43, blob: src, title Play->Pause, pause verified); download (talknet-clip-2026-07-31T18-11-53-711Z.webm); delete removes row + IDB record; persistence across reload; admin bob has NO my-clips-trigger and admin session recording still POSTs /api/admin/recordings -> 201; zero /api calls for clip save (client-only). Console is now clean — the previous empty-string <audio src> warning is fixed (0 errors/warnings captured).

integration_issues.issue: The DynamicsCompressor(-18 dB, 24 knee, 4:1) + master 0.9 chain reduces but does not eliminate clipping. Measured decoded peaks: 1 source = 0.623 (OK); 2 real loud sources (alice 300Hz + bob 700Hz oscillators @0.9) = 1.045; synthetic sweep through the identical graph: 3 sources @0.3 = 0.685 / 0 clipped, 3 @0.5 = 0.93 / 0 clipped, 4 @0.9 = 1.038 with 2025 of 118080 samples at full scale (1.7% hard-clipped). It IS a big improvement over iteration_11 (2-source peak was 1.26), but the stated goal 'peak <= 1.0 with 3+ simultaneous speakers' is not guaranteed for loud/coherent sources. Recommend a true limiter stage: ratio 12-20 with threshold ~-6 dB, knee ~6, plus master gain ~0.7-0.8, or scale per-source gain by 1/N of the currently attached sources.

issues: Participant card stretches to ~600px tall with content only in the top-left/bottom-left corners — huge empty red block; consider a fixed/compact card height.
My clips popover itself is clean: header 'KEPT 48H · N SAVED', TTL badge and note input have adequate contrast.

action_items: Strengthen the clip mix limiter so decoded peak stays <= 1.0 with 3+ loud sources (higher ratio / lower threshold / 1/N per-source gain, master ~0.75).
Optional: RoomPage.jsx is now 1314 lines — extract ClipRow and the clip recorder into components/hooks (previously reported, still open).
critical_code_review_comments: startClipRecording/stopClipRecording are now correctly listed in the startTalking/stopTalking dep arrays; stopClipRecording still depends on roomMeta, so the unmount cleanup effect (which transitively depends on it) would re-run and disconnect a LIVE session if /room/info is ever refetched — use a ref-based cleanup.

Late-joiner attach() keys on pub.trackSid || track.sid while the initial snapshot keys on pub.track.sid; if LiveKit ever reports differing values a track could be attached twice (double-gain). Prefer one consistent key source.
clipStore._purgeExpired deletes clips whose created_at is unparseable (t falsy) — a clip written with a malformed date silently disappears; acceptable but worth logging.
Clips still grow unbounded in IndexedDB inside the 48h window; addClip failures (QuotaExceededError) are swallowed with no user feedback.

Room feb97dad-08c7-4de0-b28d-fabb4a85719d. Override getUserMedia with an oscillator MediaStreamDestination via add_init_script for non-empty audio. In one multi-context run bob's room-record-toggle-button did not render (30s timeout) while a dedicated single-context bob run rendered it and POSTed 201 — treat as a test-side auth/me race, retest if seen again.
rca_of_the_issue: Mix limiter shortfall: a DynamicsCompressor with threshold -18 dB, knee 24 and ratio 4:1 provides only ~4:1 soft gain reduction above the knee, so N coherent sources at 0.85 gain each still sum above unity (3x0.765 = 2.29 in => ~1.03 out after master 0.9). Compression is not limiting; a high ratio (>=12) with a lower threshold, or dividing per-source gain by the live source count, is required to hard-cap the mix at <=1.0.
